نستبصر (form X)
# نَسْتَبْصِرُ (nastabṣiru) /nas.tab.sˤi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبْصَرَ (istabṣara)
# نَسْتَبْصِرَ (nastabṣira) /nas.tab.sˤi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَبْصَرَ (istabṣara)
# نَسْتَبْصِرْ (nastabṣir) /nas.tab.sˤir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَبْصَرَ (istabṣara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
